Kit summary

Star BurstBasic
Deals DMG by 14% of Mavilla's Max HP to a single enemy (considered as [HP Burning] DMG), with a 100% chance to inflict [Crit DMG Down II] for 2 turns. If the layers of [HP Burning] owned by the target haven't reached the limit, there is a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns.
Recovery StarlightActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Revives all dead allies with 25% of Max HP, and grants all allies [HP Up II] for 2 turns. Afterward, grants [Ally Protection] on all allies, lasting for 3 of Mavilla's turns, Mavilla will bear 40% of the DMG taken by allies.
Scepter of Glory Lv.2Recovery Starlight: Revives all dead allies with 40% of Max HP instead and increases the revived ally's Turn Meter by 30%. Besides, at the beginning of anyone's turn, casts Recovery Starlight once immediately if an ally is dead; this effect can be triggered once each wave and will still take effect when Mavilla is controlled.
Scepter of Glory Lv.3[Energized]: Increases the boost effect to 150% of the original and Mavilla will reduce the CD of all her skills by 1 turn. When the turn of the ally with [Ally Protection] ends, Mavilla will pursue and attack a random enemy once.
Star of GloryPassiveExclusive Lv.3
For every 1% Healing Effect owned by Mavilla (up to 120%), additionally increases Max HP and Shield Effect by 0.26%. Each time when allies inflict 20 layers of [HP Burning], Mavilla will grant [Energized] on allies for 2 turns. [Energized]: For every 1% Healing Effect owned by Mavilla (up to 120%), increases 0.26% Mastery for allies with [HP Burning] tag.
Scepter of Glory Lv.3[Energized]: Increases the boost effect to 150% of the original and Mavilla will reduce the CD of all her skills by 1 turn. When the turn of the ally with [Ally Protection] ends, Mavilla will pursue and attack a random enemy once.
Starlight NightActiveExclusive Lv.1
Cleanses all DoT debuffs from all allies and grants them a [Shield] by 40% of Mavilla's Max HP for 2 turns.
Scepter of Glory Lv.1For every 1 ally with [Ally Protection] exists, reduces Mavilla's Direct DMG and DoT taken by 8%, up to 32%. Besides, the DMG borne by Mavilla for allies is reduced by 20% and the reduced part will be stored. When Starlight Night is cast, all the stored DMG will be consumed to increase the Shield value granted by Mavilla, up to 20% of Mavilla's Max HP.
